title: 5d-2: constraint types + rules parsing
description:
## Parent

sutra/68 — 5d PRD: constraint system + DD integration

## What to build

New `Constraint` struct and `[[constraint]]` TOML parsing in `rules.rs`. Each constraint carries kind, per-instance severity (blocking/advisory/informational with per-kind defaults), optional human name, optional provenance (ADR path or rationale text), optional scope (path prefix or component), and kind-specific fields. Identity via blake3 hash of (kind, normalized_params). Backward compatible — old `[constraints]` section with `forbidden_deps` array still parses.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `Constraint` struct with all fields
- [ ] `[[constraint]]` TOML parsing
- [ ] Old `[constraints]` backward compat
- [ ] Blake3 identity hashing
- [ ] Per-kind severity defaults
- [ ] Full test coverage for parsing + identity

## Blocked by

- sutra/69 — 5d-1: rename dd/ → constraints/

acceptance_criteria.text: ✅ New Constraint struct with kind (forbidden_dep, boundary, max_fan_in, no_cycles), severity, name, provenance, scope, kind-specific fields
✅ [[constraint]] TOML array format parses correctly in .sutra/rules.toml
✅ Old [constraints] format with forbidden_deps still parses, produces Constraint structs with kind=forbidden_dep, severity=blocking
✅ Both old and new format in same file works without conflict
✅ Constraint identity: blake3 hash of (kind, normalized_params), stable and deterministic
✅ Name field does not affect identity hash
✅ Missing optional fields get correct defaults (severity defaults per kind)
✅ Unknown constraint kind produces clear error
✅ Tests cover: new format, old format, mixed format, identity hashing, defaults, errors
